Definition: from a compound of G473 and G3408; requital, correspondence:--recompense.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says the men who left the natural use of the woman received in themselves the recompense of their error which was meet, and the Corinthians are asked to give him the same requital, to be enlarged in return for his open heart. The word is the return made in kind, the fitting answer to what was done.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for a fitting return carries no doctrine of its own; its gravity is Paul's, that error is repaid in the error itself.
